name: Mental Misstep
oracle_text:
({U/P} can be paid with either {U} or 2 life.)
Counter target spell with mana value 1.
blocked_sentences: ({U/P} can be paid with either {U} or 2 life.)

needs.what: a Phyrexian pip ({W/P}, {U/P}, {B/P}, {R/P}, {G/P}) inside a printed `mana_cost` string: a symbol the caster may satisfy either with one mana of that colour or by paying 2 life, while still counting 1 toward mana value and still contributing its colour to the card's colour and colour identity. The parser must accept it, the payer must be offered the life branch as a choice at cast time (Phyrexian mana is optional per-symbol, and the choice is made while paying costs, not on resolution), and the resulting spell must remain the printed colour even when no coloured mana was spent. Wanted by the whole Phyrexian cycle -- Mental Misstep, Gitaxian Probe, Mutagenic Growth, Dismember, Surgical Extraction, Apostle's Blessing, Birthing Pod, Vault Skirge, Porcelain Legionnaire and Norn's Choirmaster's descendants.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `_parse_hybrid` (src/automtg/engine/mana.py:241-262) raises DslError on any half of a hybrid symbol that is not a digit or a colour, so `{U/P}` will not load at all: the comment there says the rejection is deliberate, because `HybridPip` models a *colour choice* and treating P as a colour would make every Phyrexian card cheaper than printed. Going the other way is no better: dropping to a plain `{U}` (what `starting_point` proposes) silently deletes the alternative payment that is the entire reason this card is played, and there is nothing in `card_level_cost_keys` to put it back. `alternative_cost` is a whole-cost replacement priced in mana, not a per-symbol substitution, and it cannot charge life -- Mental Misstep's life branch is `{U/P}` paid as 2 life, i.e. a *total* cost of `{0}` plus 2 life, which as an `alternative_cost` would need a mana-free entry the loader rejects (it hard-requires `mana`). `pay_life` exists only in `cost_keys`, which is the activated-ability cost language and has no reach into a spell's printed mana cost. Every workaround also gets the mana value wrong or the colour wrong, and this card's own mana value of 1 is load-bearing: Mental Misstep is legal targeting itself. The shape to extend is HybridPip itself, which already models 'either/or' inside a cost -- with life rather than a second colour on the right-hand side.
